theorem weighted_integrable (m k : ℕ) (T B : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (weighted m k T B) (Ici 0)
def flow (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ
theorem flow_differentiable (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : Differentiable ℂ (flow m t)

theorem maxima_escape (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    ∀ᶠ t in atTop, ∀ u ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ),
      IsMaxOn (weighted m 0 t 0) (Ici 0) u → R < u

theorem max_complex_stationary (m : ℕ) (t u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u)
    (hm : IsMaxOn (weighted m 0 t 0) (Ici 0) u) :
    ((2*m : ℕ) : ℂ)*(t : ℂ)*(u : ℂ)^(2*m-1)+
      RiemannThetaComplexKernel.kernelDerivative (u : ℂ)/
        RiemannThetaComplexKernel.kernelComplex (u : ℂ) = 0

theorem eventually_exists_nondegenerate_saddle (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in atTop, ∃ u : ℝ, R < u ∧
      IsMaxOn (weighted m 0 t 0) (Ici 0) u ∧ phaseSlope m t u = 0 ∧
      deriv (phaseSlope m t) u < 0

theorem scaled_neighbor_error (t K : ℝ) (z w v : ℂ)
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hK : 8 ≤ K) (hr : 10000 ≤ w.re)
    (hmargin : t*w.re^5+8 ≤ 4*Real.pi*(Complex.exp (4*w)).re) (hi : |w.im| ≤ 1/2)
    (hy : z.im ≤ 1) (hs : modelDerivative 3 t w= -(Complex.I*z))
    (hE : ‖Complex.exp (4*w)‖ ≤ K) (hv : ‖v-w‖ ≤ 2/K) :
    ‖complexSlope 3 t v-modelDerivative 3 t v‖ ≤ 30005*Real.exp (-w.re)

theorem scaled_actual_real_curvature (t K : ℝ) (z w v : ℂ)
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hK : 8 ≤ K) (hr : 10000 ≤ w.re)
    (hmargin : t*w.re^5+8 ≤ 4*Real.pi*(Complex.exp (4*w)).re) (hi : |w.im| ≤ 1/2)
    (hn : ‖w‖ ≤ 2*w.re) (hy : z.im ≤ 1) (hs : modelDerivative 3 t w= -(Complex.I*z))
    (hE : ‖Complex.exp (4*w)‖ ≤ K)
    (hsmall : (30005*Real.exp (-w.re))*K ≤ t*w.re^5/4)
    (hv : v ∈ closedBall w (1/K)) :
    (deriv (complexSlope 3 t) v).re ≤ -2*t*w.re^5

theorem actual_transition_saddle (t u M : ℝ) (z : ℂ)
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hu : 65536*(M+7) ≤ u)
    (hs : phaseSlope 3 t u=0) (hy : z.im ≤ 1) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ M*realScale u) :
    ∃ v : ℂ, 0 ≤ v.re ∧ 1 ≤ (Complex.exp (4*v)).re ∧ kernelComplex v ≠ 0 ∧
      complexSlope 3 t v= -(Complex.I*z) ∧ deriv (complexSlope 3 t) v ≠ 0 ∧
      (deriv (complexSlope 3 t) v).re ≤ -(t*u^5/16) ∧ ‖v-(u : ℂ)‖ ≤ M+8

theorem local_actual_saddle_branch (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (z v : ℂ)
    (hE : 0 < (Complex.exp (4*v)).re) (hk : kernelComplex v ≠ 0)
    (hr : complexSlope m t v= -(Complex.I*z)) (hn : deriv (complexSlope m t) v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ branch : ℂ → ℂ, branch z=v ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ branch z ∧
      HasStrictDerivAt branch (-Complex.I/deriv (complexSlope m t) v) z ∧
      ∀ᶠ q in nhds z, complexSlope m t (branch q)= -(Complex.I*q) ∧
        0 < (Complex.exp (4*branch q)).re ∧ kernelComplex (branch q) ≠ 0

theorem criticalValue_log_derivative (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z-(x : ℂ)‖ < 1) :
    deriv (criticalValue t x ht hx w hr hi hp hs) z/criticalValue t x ht hx w hr hi hp hs z = Complex.I*B z

theorem relative_actual_branch_endpoint_bound (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z-(x : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖(∫ y : ℝ in (B (conj z)).im..(B z).im, weight 3 t z ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I))/
      modelGaussianAmplitude t z (B z)‖ ≤
      1056*Real.sqrt x*Real.exp (5*(B z).re+3-2*t*(B z).re^5)

theorem exists_uniform_actual_complex_pair :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ X : ℝ, ∀ t u x : ℝ,
      1 ≤ t → 120021 ≤ u → RiemannEvenRealSaddle.phaseSlope 3 t u = 0 →
      max X (K*RiemannQuarticTransitionSaddle.realScale u) ≤ x →
      ∃ w : ℂ, ∃ (hx : 10000 ≤ x) (hr : 120020 ≤ w.re) (hi : |w.im| ≤ 1/2)
        (hp : 10000*(t*(‖w‖+1)^5+1) ≤ x)
        (hs : modelDerivative 3 t w = -(Complex.I*(x : ℂ))),
        ∃ B : ℂ → ℂ, (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z-(x : ℂ)‖ < 1 → AnalyticAt ℂ B z) ∧
        ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z-(x : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 →
          B z ∈ closedBall w (1/x) ∧ complexSlope 3 t (B z) = -(Complex.I*z) ∧
          |(B z).im| < Real.pi/8 ∧ modelGaussianAmplitude t z (B z) ≠ 0 ∧
          modelGaussianAmplitude t (conj z) (B (conj z)) ≠ 0 ∧
          IntervalIntegrable (fun y : ℝ => weight 3 t z ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I))
            volume (B (conj z)).im (B z).im ∧
          RiemannEvenFlow.flow 3 t z =
            (horizontalIntegral 3 t z (B z).im+
              conj (horizontalIntegral 3 t (conj z) (B (conj z)).im)+
              Complex.I*(∫ y : ℝ in (B (conj z)).im..(B z).im,
                weight 3 t z ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)))/2 ∧
          ‖(∫ y : ℝ in (B (conj z)).im..(B z).im, weight 3 t z ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I))/
            modelGaussianAmplitude t z (B z)‖ ≤ η ∧
          ‖RiemannEvenFlow.flow 3 t z-
            (modelGaussianAmplitude t z (B z)+conj (modelGaussianAmplitude t (conj z) (B (conj z))))/2‖ ≤
            η*(‖modelGaussianAmplitude t z (B z)‖+‖modelGaussianAmplitude t (conj z) (B (conj z))‖)

theorem exists_uniform_actual_far_saddles :

theorem uniform_actual_far_zeros_real_simple :

      RiemannEvenRealSaddle.phaseSlope 3 t u = 0 → ∀ z : ℂ,

theorem eventually_all_zeros_real_simple :

      z.im=0 ∧ deriv (RiemannEvenFlow.flow 3 t) z ≠ 0

human_reorganization: Sections 2–4 consolidate the actual theta-kernel, Gaussian, reflection and analytic pair estimates in admissible actual saddles with unspecified absolute constants. The formal source uses explicit separate model, correction, transition and far budgets.
The proof computes the sixth-order physical-prefix exponent difference -9*t*a^5/2+O(t*a^4), and the power-five moving-center coverage explicitly.
The finite-radius confinement on bounded time ranges in Proposition 6.2 is a human corollary of its explicit far-frequency condition, not a claimed separately named Lean declaration.
The generic local cosine lemma is reproved here; it is a regrouping of the buffered-zero mechanism reused by the formal sixth-order development.
